title: 내모남불 ⑦ 군대편 · 작업 · 청소 · 휴가 · 행군

lines.en: Uncle, I'm home on leave!
lines.style: cheerful, polite young soldier arriving at a restaurant

lines.en: Oh, Private First Class! Let me tell you, back in my day…
lines.style: proud, nostalgic, starting a long old-army story

lines.en: Whatever the seniors make us do… it's all bullying…
lines.style: a young private in his early twenties, timid and whispering, scared but complaining under his breath

lines.text: 야, 막내! 양말 좀 개 봐. 이건 교육이야~
lines.en: Hey, rookie! Fold my socks. It's for your training~
lines.style: the same man two years later as a lazy, smug sergeant, drawling and self-satisfied

lines.en: Uncle, that's against regulations now.
…Huh?
lines.style: stunned, caught off guard

lines.text: 이등병 땐 갑질, 병장 땐 교육. 내모남불, 하나.
lines.en: As a private: bullying. As a sergeant: training. Double standard, number one.
I'm… Modapman.

lines.text: 사건 개요. 토요일 저녁, 고깃집. 조카 휴가 기념.
lines.en: Case summary. Saturday night, Korean BBQ. Celebrating a nephew's leave.
Dad, what's "jjam"?

lines.text: 군대에서 먹은 밥그릇 수. 많을수록 세지.
lines.en: How many army meals you've eaten. The more, the stronger.
Just four rounds. Round one: work detail.
lines.tts: 딱 네 판만 하죠. 일 라운드, 작업.

lines.en: We're digging in the blazing sun, and the sergeant just "supervises" from the shade…
lines.style: a young private in his early twenties, timid and whispering, scared but complaining under his breath

lines.en: Hey, nice shovel angle there~
How is that work?!
lines.style: a young private grumbling furiously inside his head, hushed

lines.text: 난 경험으로 지휘하는 거야~ 모 어때.
lines.en: I lead with experience~ So what.
lines.style: the same man two years later as a lazy, smug sergeant, drawling and self-satisfied

lines.en: So you were in the shade too?

lines.text: 남이 쉬면 농땡이, 내가 쉬면 지휘. 내모남불, 둘.
lines.en: They rest: slacking. I rest: leadership. Double standard, number two.

lines.text: 남이 쉬면 게을러서, 내가 쉬면 사정이 있어서.
lines.en: When others rest, they're lazy. When I rest, I have my reasons.
It's called the actor-observer bias.
Round two: cleaning.
Everything's spotless, even the window frames!
lines.style: a young private reporting loudly and nervously, eager to please

lines.en: Dust. Again.
Dust. Again~
lines.style: the same man two years later as a lazy, smug sergeant, drawling and self-satisfied

lines.en: Sergeant, your locker… there's ramen soup…
That's not dirt. That's a memory.
lines.style: the same man two years later as a lazy, smug sergeant, drawling and self-satisfied

lines.text: 남의 먼지는 불량, 내 먼지는 추억. 내모남불, 셋.
lines.en: Their dust: a violation. My dust: a memory. Double standard, number three.

lines.text: 남의 허점은 잘 보이고 내 건 안 보이는 거, 편향 맹점이래요.
lines.en: Seeing others' flaws but not your own — that's the bias blind spot.
…The meat's burning. Flip it.
lines.style: embarrassed, quickly changing the subject

lines.en: Round three: leave.

lines.text: 좋은 날짜는 고참들이 다 가져가고, 전 남은 날만…
lines.en: The seniors take all the good dates, and I get the leftovers…
lines.style: a young private in his early twenties, timid and whispering, scared but complaining under his breath

lines.en: Leave goes by seniority. Obviously.
lines.style: the same man two years later as a lazy, smug sergeant, drawling and self-satisfied

lines.en: Um… I'd like to request leave next month…
Already?!
lines.style: a smug sergeant, shocked and offended

lines.text: 남이 가면 벌써, 내가 가면 당연. 내모남불, 넷.
lines.en: They go: already? I go: obviously. Double standard, number four.

lines.text: 삼촌, 휴가는 짬이 아니라 법으로 보장돼요.
lines.en: Uncle, leave isn't about seniority. It's guaranteed by law.
"Service members are guaranteed leave, passes, and overnights."
lines.style: reading a rule out loud, flat and precise

lines.en: That's in the LAW?!
lines.style: genuinely shocked

lines.en: Final round four: the march.

lines.text: 고참 짐까지 메고… 이거 갑질 아닙니까…
lines.en: Carrying the seniors' packs too… isn't this bullying…
lines.style: a young private panting under heavy packs, muttering very quietly

lines.text: 나 전역 D-30이야. 민간인한테 짐 지우면, 그게 불법이지!
lines.en: I'm 30 days from discharge. Making a civilian carry stuff? Now THAT'S illegal!
lines.tts: 나 전역 디 마이너스 삼십이야. 민간인한테 짐 지우면, 그게 불법이지!
lines.style: the same man two years later as a lazy, smug sergeant, drawling and self-satisfied

lines.en: Isn't this bullying…
lines.style: panting under two heavy packs, muttering very quietly

lines.en: Kids these days, so mouthy~
lines.style: the same man two years later as a lazy, smug sergeant, drawling and self-satisfied

lines.text: 내가 하면 할 말, 남이 하면 말대꾸. 내모남불, 다섯.
lines.en: When I say it: speaking up. When they say it: talking back. Double standard, number five.
Uncle, 30 days left is still a soldier.

lines.text: 지금 안 힘들면, 힘든 사람 아픔을 작게 본대요. 공감 격차.
lines.en: When you're not hurting, you underestimate someone else's pain. The empathy gap.
Bonus round. Rapid-fire double standards!

lines.text: 남이 채널 잡으면 독재, 내가 잡으면 짬!
lines.en: They hog the remote: dictatorship. I do: seniority!
lines.style: fast, punchy, rapid-fire comedy

lines.text: 남이 먼저 씻으면 새치기, 내가 먼저 씻으면 서열!
lines.en: They shower first: cutting in line. I do: rank!
lines.style: fast, punchy, rapid-fire comedy

lines.text: 남이 고기 두 점이면 욕심, 내가 두 점이면 체력 관리!
lines.en: They take two pieces: greedy. I do: fitness management!
lines.style: fast, punchy, rapid-fire comedy

lines.en: Double standard: six, seven, eight!

lines.text: 그래도 라떼는 낭만이 있었지. 요즘 군대는 편하지?
lines.en: Still, back in my day there was romance. The army's easy these days, right?
lines.style: nostalgic and a little smug

lines.text: 편한 게 아니라, 시키는 사람이 없어요.
lines.en: It's not easy. There's just nobody bossing you around.

lines.text: 동기끼리 방 쓰는 데가 많고, 일과 끝나면 폰도 해요.
lines.en: A lot of units room you with your own intake, and after hours we can use our phones.
…Then who bosses the rookie around?
lines.style: confused, genuinely lost

lines.en: Nobody.
Dad, was it hard being a private?
lines.style: soft, gentle, sincere

lines.en: Yeah. Really hard.
lines.style: quiet, honest, warm

lines.text: 그럼 형도 지금 힘들겠다. 오늘은 아빠가 구워 줘.
lines.en: Then it must be hard for him now too. You grill today, Dad.
lines.style: soft, gentle, sincere

lines.en: …Okay. Tonight, your uncle grills.
lines.style: touched, warm, a small smile

lines.text: 자, 막내! 쌈 싸서 아빠 입에~
lines.en: Alright, rookie! Wrap one up and feed it to Daddy~
lines.style: cheerfully bossy, holding tongs like a sergeant

lines.en: Uncle, that's against regulations now.
This is a BBQ restaurant!
lines.style: flustered, protesting

lines.text: 여보, 당신 전역한 지 이십 년이야.
lines.en: Honey, you were discharged twenty years ago.

lines.text: 남이 시키면 갑질, 내가 시키면 가족 사랑. 내모남불, 아홉.
lines.en: They give orders: bullying. I give orders: family love. Double standard, number nine.

lines.text: 집게는 바뀌었지만, 짬은 그대로였습니다. 그냥 오답.
lines.en: The tongs changed hands, but the seniority stayed. Just a wrong answer.
…Classic Modapman.
